score.method: score = 100 × Σ weight × factor ÷ Σ weight, over MEASURED factors only; missing factors are listed and left out (weights re-scaled)

verdict_rule: Verdict = Search Trends now. A verdict expires when its newest supporting observation is older than the limit: search 3 h (30 min for a row about a big match in its live window), reading 3 days. An expired Promote now / Promote becomes Re-check, with the age shown. A match is over — never Promote / Promote now — once its live window has passed (the start listed on the fixture calendar, else the usual start for its format in India, + the format's usual length + 1 h), a date-only fixture once its day has passed (06:00 IST the next day), Google's RSS has ended the match trend, its headlines report a result, or — for a match the fixture calendar does not hold — its own trend window has ended.
